sources.title: Can Agent Memory Systems Track Evolving State?
sources.evidence_provenance: Provenance-bound first-party arXiv abstract/fulltext cache from new-idea-source-review-20260823, independently cross-checked against current arXiv HTML on 2026-08-24.
sources.note: StateMemBench cleanly isolates current-state versus superseded-state errors and StateMem explicitly tracks supersession plus dependency invalidation. The paper provides unusually strong component evidence: drift persists under perfect retrieval, the state wrapper improves six memory/retrieval backends, and a length/cost-matched control attributes a substantial portion of the gain to state structure rather than extra context. Nevertheless, state structure is supplied as observable typed state/revision information. Once a strongest state compiler or typed-belief-revision baseline receives the identical event chronology, supersession/dependency relations, provenance, memory budget, query and backbone, the source does not report an additional irreducible longitudinal state variable or opposite prediction. A prior exact-reduction screen reached the same conclusion.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: Withhold the decisive validity/supersession relation from all methods and require an equally observable signal that forces the typed-belief baseline and explicit state-tracking mechanism to make different ex-ante predictions, rather than different implementation accuracies.

sources.title: MemTrapBench: Benchmarking Cognitive Traps in LLM Memory Use
sources.evidence_provenance: Current first-party arXiv abstract independently reviewed on 2026-08-24; no provenance-bound local fulltext cache was available in the clean review substrate, so no independent source/fulltext SHA is asserted here.
sources.note: MemTrapBench directly demonstrates a strong failure phenomenon: faithfully recorded and semantically relevant memory can degrade current-task reasoning, and across two model families and five memory frameworks every evaluated memory strategy underperforms no-memory, with even the strongest dropping by more than ten percent. AdaptiveMem is an inference-time instruction designed to avoid those traps. This strengthens the empirical case for memory harm but remains expressible by negative transfer, fixation/belief distortion and non-monotonic memory-use baselines. The source does not isolate a persistent self-evolution state or an outcome-independent fixed-content order/path residual.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: Memory-induced degradation is compatible with ordinary negative transfer unless a matched persistent state predicts gain/harm sign beyond compatibility, conflict structure, task distribution and observable memory use.

sources.title: Optimal Skill Selection for LLM Agents with Provable Bicriteria Guarantees
sources.evidence_provenance: Provenance-bound first-party arXiv abstract/fulltext cache from new-idea-source-review-20260823, independently cross-checked against current arXiv HTML on 2026-08-24.
sources.note: The paper explicitly formulates bounded-context skill selection as a hard-token-budget optimization maximizing monotone submodular benefit minus context penalty and gives a bicriteria approximation algorithm. Its contamination-controlled execution benchmark reports higher task success with fewer injected tokens. This directly occupies the mature marginal-information/redundancy/context-cost set-selection basin. The treatment changes which skill set is selected, not a longitudinal state or the order/path of a fixed support/content set.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: No self-evolution-specific structural variable remains after matching selected-skill count, relevance profile, context/token budget, redundancy/complementarity, planner/backbone and observable utilization.

sources.title: ReCache: Efficient KV Cache Reuse and Compression for Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
sources.evidence_provenance: Current first-party arXiv abstract independently reviewed on 2026-08-24; no provenance-bound local fulltext cache was available in the clean review substrate, so no independent source/fulltext SHA is asserted here.
sources.note: ReCache removes cross-resource interactions and uses resource-local positions to construct composition-invariant KV blocks, then prunes visibility/fields for cache efficiency. The main evidence is systems/runtime: near-identical invocation F1 with large TTFT, KV-memory and attention-efficiency gains. The invariance is engineered into the inference representation rather than learned as a persistent self-evolution transition. It therefore does not reopen composition/state objects and is outside the longitudinal scientific scope.
